sn2.17:1.1: Probably not the same individual as the “independent divinity” Subrahmā ([sn6.6]()–8 and [dn20:20.1]()). In the Rig Veda, _subrahma_ meant “good sacred formulation” (Rig Veda 7.16.2, 10.47.3, 10.62.4)
sn2.17:3.1: PTS reads _bojjhaṅgatapasā_; Yogācārabhūmi Śarīrārthagāthā 5.2 has_jñānatapaso_; SA 596 seems to pass over _bojjha_; while SA2 181 has 智慧者, “wise one”. I follow Bodhi in accepting the MS reading, _nāññatra bojjhā tapasā_.
sn2.17:4.1: This prose fragment is unusual here. Such endings are normally abbreviated in the Pali, although they are retained in the Chinese.
